name: mysql-connection-errors
description: MySQL connectivity/operational errors from Open edX services in mereka-lms namespace.
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="mereka-lms" AND (textPayload:"Can't connect to MySQL" OR textPayload:"MySQL server has gone away" OR textPayload:"Lost connection to MySQL server" OR textPayload:"OperationalError" OR jsonPayload.message:"Can't connect to MySQL" OR jsonPayload.message:"MySQL server has gone away")
